verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE wordmark is pushed to the far left, halfway down, and sits on top of the green circle. The two circles are stacked and cramped in the left corner. The headline breaks so that 'fizz' sits alone on its own line. The body copy is jammed beside the CTA, and the bottle and button crowd the bottom and right edges. B: the reading order is clear (logo, headline, copy, CTA) and the bottle is grouped sensibly with the text. However, the end of the headline runs into the green circle, the CTA is oversized and nearly touches the body copy, there is dead space to the left of the bottle, and the text column is squeezed vertically.
